Name: Qaptis
Description: Truck & ship industry are together responsible for more than 10% of global CO2 emissions and are part of the hard-to-decarbonize sector. There is a strong pressure to bring rapid changes! However, the current solutions, like hydrogen and electric vehicles, are not ready to clean these sectors before decades. This is why we are committed to a greener tomorrow and our mission is to solve the climate change challenge in the transportation industry by capturing the emissions at their source. With our plug-in technology, our solution is able to capture up to 90% of the emitted CO2, store it in liquid form directly onboard and recycle it (fuel, plastics, building materials, CO2 sequestration).

Name: qCella
Description:
qCella develops an innovative radiant surface heating technology designed to make EV cabin heating dramatically more efficient. While electric vehicles (EVs) are essential to reaching Net Zero, inefficient cabin heating in winter can significantly cut driving range. This is a challenge that traditional air-based systems are unable to solve.

The Solution:
qCella’s paper-thin, flexible, and lightweight heating mats integrate directly into EV interior paneling, meaningfully extending driving range. These mats are customizable to almost any shape or size and harness the scalability and cost-efficiency of industrial paper manufacturing.

Versatile Applications:
Beyond mobility, our heating mats offer high-performance solutions across several industries:

Filtration: Heating filter papers for absorption-desorption processes.

Food Processing: Replacing traditional hot-water-based systems.

Lab Analytics: Providing precisely shaped, customizable heating zones.

Core Innovation & Future Potential:
Our core innovation is a material platform technology that functionalizes cellulose fibers with metal particles, such as copper or silver. The result is a non-woven mat produced via conventional paper manufacturing processes with electrically conductive and/or antibacterial properties.

While currently optimized for heating, this material platform also opens new doors in electromagnetic shielding, sensing, and specialty paper manufacturing.

Name: BCHAR
Description:
Welcome to BCHAR on LinkedIn! BCHAR offers a turn-key biochar production line that handles the entire process — from biomass input to biochar output — all from one supplier. Our solution integrates fully automated hardware with built-in MRV software, providing unmatched transparency for carbon credit generation. With its automated design, BCHAR makes turning waste into value as simple and efficient as possible.


BCHAR’s mission is to scale carbon removal by making biochar production accessible, efficient, and impactful. We aim to empower businesses to transform agricultural waste into a valuable tool for carbon removal and soil restoration. Through innovation and automation, we’re helping to drive the transition to renewable energy and a sustainable, carbon-neutral future.

Our story
BCHAR was born out of a passion to scale carbon removal and tackle climate change head-on. It all started at ETH Zurich, where our team of students built our first pyrolysis reactor — proof that even homemade setups could have big potential. This project revealed the potential for industrial-scale biochar production. After the incorporation of BCHAR, a pilot project in Thailand followed, showing us that more user-friendly, automated solutions were needed. Since then, we’ve been refining our tech, expanding our reach, and staying committed to our vision of making a global impact with innovative carbon removal systems.

Name: Dyneo Technologies SA
Description:
Dyneo works with district heating and cooling network operators to manage the economic and operational performance of their infrastructures.

Thermal networks are becoming increasingly complex: integration of renewables, stricter regulatory requirements, and growing pressure on operating costs and CAPEX. Yet many key decisions are still made using data that is difficult to interpret and act upon.

Dyneo transforms field data from each substation into actionable operational decisions, enabling operators to:
– reduce network losses
– control return temperatures
– improve overall system performance
– avoid unnecessary CAPEX investments

Dyneo is not a monitoring tool.
It is a performance management platform, used by operators to connect data, operations, and economic outcomes.

Our approach is simple: value follows the reality of the network.

Name: Arva Greentech AG
Description:
Arva Greentech provides procedures and technologies for the rapid and eco-friendly degradation of hydrocarbons in contaminated soils, track beds, and other substrates or surfaces. Arva is a Swiss-based company with offices in Berlin (Germany) and Kharkiv (Ukraine).

Arva offers the patented Arvox superoxidation process, which degrades hydrocarbons quickly, efficiently, and eco-friendly. This includes compounds found worldwide in railroads, contaminated soils, and mineral wastes. The eco-friendly reagents used result in environmentally neutral end products.

We innovate in organic pollutant removal with our patented, world-first oxygen-based cleaner, Arvox Pro: https://arvox.cleaning/ . Developed for professionals, Arvox Pro's two components release active oxygen to decompose dirt, leaving only biodegradable end products. This ensures eco-friendly, effective cleaning for surfaces like tiles, stone, wood, and more.

For private use, our Twin Power line offers a special cleaner for tough cases in the household. It effectively cleans various types of organic dirt and residues from both indoor and outdoor surfaces. For more information, visit the Twin Power homepage: https://twinpower.cleaning/ .

Name: Sixteen44
Description:
At Sixteen44, we remove methane.

Methane is an invisible, yet potent greenhouse gas that traps 80x more heat in the atmosphere than CO2. Removing it is the fastest way to cool our planet and widely acknowledged by scientists as an emergency break on climate change.

Sixteen44 has proven a world-first technology that destroys methane at hotspots, including dairy farms, landfills, and coal mines, where emissions are highest. Unlike any other existing solution, our technology works at the non-flammable, non-capturable methane concentrations which make up more than two thirds of all methane emissions worldwide.

We transform an environmental burden into a commercial asset, sharing the revenue of the resulting offsets directly with the operators.

Name: Atlantic Biochar
Description:
Morocco and West Africa have abundant agricultural residues, growing climate pressure, and a clear need for scalable, high-integrity carbon removal. Yet much of that biomass is still underused, burned, or left to decompose, while farmers face rising water stress, soil degradation, and pressure to improve productivity.

That is the problem.

Atlantic Biochar exists to turn that challenge into an investable climate solution. We are developing large-scale biochar production infrastructure in Morocco, with a platform designed to expand across West Africa. By converting agricultural and agro-industrial residues into high-quality biochar, we create durable carbon storage, improve soil health, strengthen drought resilience, and support circular economy outcomes. Our model is built for institutional investors seeking real assets, clear impact, and long-term value creation.

Atlantic Biochar is backed by A Swiss Capital Advisory SA in Geneva and designed to combine local execution with international standards. We focus on industrial scale, verifiable carbon credits, and a disciplined, bankable approach to climate infrastructure.

If you are interested in carbon removal, sustainable agriculture, or climate infrastructure in Africa, Atlantic Biochar is building the platform to watch.
